name: Interactive Shopping Cart
summary: Reference-inspired wire shopping cart with orange trim, steering casters and a sample item.
description: A reusable shopping cart with four independently rotating wheels, two front steering pivots, and an animated sample package. The gallery demonstration combines it with the existing Mall Shopper and a simple obstacle.
author: Blender-3D-Gallery / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original procedural geometry inspired by the user-provided image and specification; no third-party mesh or textures.
accuracy_notes: Illustrative cart and controlled interaction demo; not a physical equipment, safety or accessibility certification. Item and obstacle are illustrative. Physical iOS and Android devices are not tested.

attribution.credit: Original procedural geometry based on a user-supplied visual reference; demonstration character is the project's Mall Shopper.

rights: Original geometry and materials; reuse in the owner's projects is authorized. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.
